quizzes-list.control.manage-quizzes.title: Manage Quizzes
quizzes-list.control.manage-quizzes.what: The list of every quiz in the course, with each quiz’s actions menu for editing, previewing, grading and special access.
quizzes-list.control.manage-quizzes.when: Starting point for almost every quiz ticket.
howTo: Open its menu for Edit, Preview, Grade or Statistics.
quizzes-list.control.manage-quizzes.verify: Reopen the page and confirm the saved setting matches what the instructor asked for.
tickets: “Where do I go to change my quiz?”

quizzes-list.control.question-library.title: Question Library
quizzes-list.control.question-library.what: A course bank of reusable questions and sections. Questions here can be pulled into many quizzes or drawn at random.
quizzes-list.control.question-library.when: Building question pools so each learner gets a different set of questions.
howTo: In a quiz, use Add Existing to pull them in, or a random section to draw from a pool.
quizzes-list.control.question-library.verify: The quiz shows the pulled questions or the random section.
gotchas: Editing a question in the library can update every quiz that uses it. Check before changing a live question.
tickets: “How do I give each student different questions?”

quizzes-list.control.statistics.title: Quiz statistics
quizzes-list.control.statistics.what: Class averages, score distributions and per-question results for each quiz.
quizzes-list.control.statistics.when: Spotting a broken question (everyone got it wrong) or reviewing how a class did.
howTo: Switch between user, question and question detail views.
quizzes-list.control.statistics.verify: Reopen the page and confirm the saved setting matches what the instructor asked for.
gotchas: A question that nearly everyone missed is often a wrong answer key rather than a hard question.
tickets: “Is something wrong with question 7? Nobody got it.”

quizzes-list.control.lockdown-browser.title: LockDown Browser
quizzes-list.control.lockdown-browser.what: Settings for Respondus LockDown Browser, which locks the learner’s computer to the quiz while it is open.
quizzes-list.control.lockdown-browser.when: High-stakes exams that require a secure browser, where the institution licenses it.
howTo: Choose the quiz and require LockDown Browser.
quizzes-list.control.lockdown-browser.verify: Learners are prompted to open the quiz in LockDown Browser.
gotchas: Learners need the app installed first. Most failures are students on Chromebooks or tablets without it.
tickets: “My students say the quiz won’t open.”

quizzes-list.control.new-quiz.title: New Quiz
quizzes-list.control.new-quiz.what: Opens the quiz editor to build a new quiz.
quizzes-list.control.new-quiz.when: When an instructor asks about this part of the page or reports that it is not working as expected.
quizzes-list.control.new-quiz.verify: The quiz appears on the list.

quizzes-list.control.edit-categories.title: Edit quiz categories
quizzes-list.control.edit-categories.what: Creates the headings that group quizzes on the list page.
quizzes-list.control.edit-categories.when: Organizing a course with many quizzes.
howTo: Assign quizzes to them in each quiz’s settings.
quizzes-list.control.edit-categories.verify: Reopen the page and confirm the saved setting matches what the instructor asked for.
gotchas: These categories only organize the list. They do not affect grades.

quizzes-list.view.view.title: View quizzes by
quizzes-list.view.view.what: Sorts the list by availability dates or by category.
quizzes-list.view.view.when: When an instructor asks about this part of the page or reports that it is not working as expected.
quizzes-list.view.view.verify: Reopen the page and confirm the saved setting matches what the instructor asked for.

quiz-new.control.back-to-manage-quizzes.title: Back to Manage Quizzes
quiz-new.control.back-to-manage-quizzes.when: When an instructor asks about this part of the page or reports that it is not working as expected.
howTo: Save first if you want to keep changes.
quiz-new.control.back-to-manage-quizzes.verify: Reopen the page and confirm the saved setting matches what the instructor asked for.
gotchas: Leaving without saving asks whether to discard changes.

quiz-new.left-column.quiz-title.title: Quiz title
quiz-new.left-column.quiz-title.what: The name learners see in Quizzes, the course calendar, the gradebook and notifications.
quiz-new.left-column.quiz-title.when: Always. A clear title is the first thing a learner searches for.
howTo: Replace Untitled with a specific name, such as “Unit 3 Quiz” or “Lab Report 2”.
Save. The new name appears everywhere the activity is listed.
quiz-new.left-column.quiz-title.verify: The list page shows the new name after Save and Close.
gotchas: Renaming does not rename a grade item created earlier under a different name in older workflows; check the gradebook if names drift.
tickets: “Students can’t find the quiz I posted.”

quiz-new.left-column.grade-out-of.title: Grade Out Of
quiz-new.left-column.grade-out-of.what: The quiz total, calculated from the point values of its questions. It updates as questions are added.
quiz-new.left-column.grade-out-of.when: When an instructor asks about this part of the page or reports that it is not working as expected.
howTo: Add questions and set their points; the total follows.
quiz-new.left-column.grade-out-of.verify: The total matches the sum of question points.
gotchas: A quiz worth 0 points will not affect any grade even if it is in the gradebook.
tickets: “Why is my quiz out of 0?”

quiz-new.control.not-in-grade-book.title: Grade book link
quiz-new.control.not-in-grade-book.what: Connects the quiz to a gradebook item so scores flow into Grades. Not in Grade Book means scores stay in Quizzes only.
quiz-new.control.not-in-grade-book.when: Any quiz that counts toward the final grade.
howTo: Add to the grade book, or link to an existing grade item.
quiz-new.control.not-in-grade-book.verify: The quiz score appears in Grades after an attempt is published.
gotchas: “Quiz grade missing from Grades” is usually this being left as Not in Grade Book, or results not being published.
tickets: “My quiz scores aren’t showing in the gradebook.”

quiz-new.left-column.due-date.title: Due Date
quiz-new.left-column.due-date.what: The deadline learners see. It marks work as late after this time but does not by itself stop attempts.
quiz-new.left-column.due-date.when: Whenever the activity has a deadline that should appear in the calendar and on learner to-do lists.
howTo: Set the End Date under Availability Dates & Conditions if access should close.
quiz-new.left-column.due-date.verify: The date shows on the list page and in the course calendar.
gotchas: Due Date and End Date are different. Due marks late; End Date closes access. Most “students submitted after the deadline” tickets come from setting only one of them.
Times use the time zone shown on the page. Confirm it matches the instructor’s intent.
tickets: “Why could a student still submit after the due date?”
“The deadline shows the wrong time.”

quiz-new.left-column.description.title: Description
quiz-new.left-column.description.what: Instructions learners see before starting: rules, allowed materials, time limit reminders.
quiz-new.left-column.description.when: When an instructor asks about this part of the page or reports that it is not working as expected.
quiz-new.left-column.description.verify: Reopen the page and confirm the saved setting matches what the instructor asked for.

quiz-new.control.preview.title: Preview quiz
quiz-new.control.preview.what: Shows the quiz as a learner would see it, without recording an attempt.
quiz-new.control.preview.when: Checking questions and layout before releasing the quiz.
quiz-new.control.preview.verify: Reopen the page and confirm the saved setting matches what the instructor asked for.
gotchas: Preview does not apply special access or accommodations. Do not use it to verify extra time.

quiz-new.control.add-existing.title: Add existing questions
quiz-new.control.add-existing.what: Pulls questions from the Question Library or another source into this quiz.
howTo: Choose the source and select questions.
quiz-new.control.add-existing.verify: The questions appear in the quiz list.

quiz-new.control.create-new.title: Create a new question
quiz-new.control.create-new.what: Writes a new question directly in this quiz: multiple choice, true or false, written response, and more. Also adds sections.
quiz-new.control.create-new.when: When an instructor asks about this part of the page or reports that it is not working as expected.
howTo: Click Create New and pick a question type.
Write the question, answers and points.
Save the question, then save the quiz.
quiz-new.control.create-new.verify: Reopen the page and confirm the saved setting matches what the instructor asked for.
gotchas: Written response questions need manual grading, so the quiz score stays incomplete until they are marked.
tickets: “Why does the quiz show no score yet?”

quiz-new.availability-dates-conditions.s.title: Start Date
quiz-new.availability-dates-conditions.s.where: Quizzes > New Quiz > Availability Dates & Conditions
quiz-new.availability-dates-conditions.s.what: The quiz cannot be opened before this time. Depending on display settings, learners may still see it listed.
quiz-new.availability-dates-conditions.s.when: Use with the Due Date to control exactly when work can happen.
howTo: Set the Start Date date and time.
quiz-new.availability-dates-conditions.s.verify: Reopen the activity and check the saved date and time.
gotchas: For one learner who needs different dates, use Special Access instead of moving the dates for the whole class.
tickets: “My students can already see the quiz before it should open.”

quiz-new.availability-dates-conditions.e.title: End Date
quiz-new.availability-dates-conditions.e.where: Quizzes > New Quiz > Availability Dates & Conditions
quiz-new.availability-dates-conditions.e.what: Access closes at this time. After it, learners can no longer start the quiz, unless they have special access.
quiz-new.availability-dates-conditions.e.when: Use with the Due Date to control exactly when work can happen.
howTo: Set the End Date date and time.
quiz-new.availability-dates-conditions.e.verify: Reopen the activity and check the saved date and time.
gotchas: For one learner who needs different dates, use Special Access instead of moving the dates for the whole class.
tickets: “A student could not start the quiz in the evening.”

quiz-new.control.add-release-condition.title: Release conditions
quiz-new.control.add-release-condition.where: Quizzes > New Quiz > Availability Dates & Conditions
quiz-new.control.add-release-condition.what: Hides the quiz until a learner meets a condition, such as completing a content topic or scoring above a threshold on another activity.
quiz-new.control.add-release-condition.when: Sequencing work, such as unlocking a quiz only after the reading is viewed.
howTo: Choose Add Release Condition and pick the condition type.
quiz-new.control.add-release-condition.verify: Check as a test learner, or confirm the condition is listed under Release Conditions.
gotchas: This is the most common cause of “my student cannot see it”. Always check release conditions before anything else.
Conditions combine. With several conditions, check whether all or any must be met.
tickets: “One student can’t see the quiz but everyone else can.”

quiz-new.availability-dates-conditions-r.title: Release conditions
quiz-new.availability-dates-conditions-r.where: Quizzes > New Quiz > Availability Dates & Conditions
quiz-new.availability-dates-conditions-r.what: Hides the quiz until a learner meets a condition, such as completing a content topic or scoring above a threshold on another activity.
quiz-new.availability-dates-conditions-r.when: Sequencing work, such as unlocking a quiz only after the reading is viewed.
howTo: Choose Add Release Condition and pick the condition type.
quiz-new.availability-dates-conditions-r.verify: Check as a test learner, or confirm the condition is listed under Release Conditions.
gotchas: This is the most common cause of “my student cannot see it”. Always check release conditions before anything else.
Conditions combine. With several conditions, check whether all or any must be met.
tickets: “One student can’t see the quiz but everyone else can.”

quiz-new.control.manage-special-access.title: Manage Special Access
quiz-new.control.manage-special-access.where: Quizzes > New Quiz > Availability Dates & Conditions > Special Access
quiz-new.control.manage-special-access.what: Opens the exceptions list for this one quiz: different dates, a different time limit or more attempts for selected learners, without changing anything for the rest of the class.
quiz-new.control.manage-special-access.when: One learner needs an extension, a make-up window or extra time on this activity only.
howTo: Choose whether special access adds exceptions or restricts who can see the activity.
Add Users to Special Access, set their dates or limits, select the learner and save.
quiz-new.control.manage-special-access.verify: The learner appears in the special access list with the new dates or limits.
gotchas: For extra time on every quiz in the course, use Classlist > Edit Accommodations instead.
Quiz Preview does not apply special access. Verify with the saved record, not a preview.
tickets: “Can you give one student until Monday?”
“A student was sick and needs a make-up window.”

quiz-new.availability-dates-conditions-s.title: Manage Special Access
quiz-new.availability-dates-conditions-s.where: Quizzes > New Quiz > Availability Dates & Conditions > Special Access
quiz-new.availability-dates-conditions-s.what: Opens the exceptions list for this one quiz: different dates, a different time limit or more attempts for selected learners, without changing anything for the rest of the class.
quiz-new.availability-dates-conditions-s.when: One learner needs an extension, a make-up window or extra time on this activity only.
howTo: Choose whether special access adds exceptions or restricts who can see the activity.
Add Users to Special Access, set their dates or limits, select the learner and save.
quiz-new.availability-dates-conditions-s.verify: The learner appears in the special access list with the new dates or limits.
gotchas: For extra time on every quiz in the course, use Classlist > Edit Accommodations instead.
Quiz Preview does not apply special access. Verify with the saved record, not a preview.
tickets: “Can you give one student until Monday?”
“A student was sick and needs a make-up window.”

quiz-new.availability-dates-conditions.p.title: Quiz password
quiz-new.availability-dates-conditions.p.where: Quizzes > New Quiz > Availability Dates & Conditions
quiz-new.availability-dates-conditions.p.what: Learners must type this password to start the quiz. Often used for in-room exams where the instructor reads the password aloud.
howTo: Share it with learners at the start of the sitting.
quiz-new.availability-dates-conditions.p.verify: Starting the quiz asks for the password.
gotchas: A forgotten or mistyped password is a frequent “quiz won’t start” ticket. Check this field first.
tickets: “The quiz is asking my students for a password.”

quiz-new.control.manage-ip-restrictions.title: IP restrictions
quiz-new.control.manage-ip-restrictions.where: Quizzes > New Quiz > Availability Dates & Conditions
quiz-new.control.manage-ip-restrictions.what: Limits the quiz to computers on specific network addresses, such as a testing lab.
quiz-new.control.manage-ip-restrictions.verify: Reopen the page and confirm the saved setting matches what the instructor asked for.
gotchas: Learners on home or mobile networks will be blocked. Check this when only remote students report the quiz is unavailable.
tickets: “Students at home can’t open the exam.”

quiz-new.availability-dates-conditions-s.title: Lock attempt to one session
quiz-new.availability-dates-conditions-s.where: Quizzes > New Quiz > Availability Dates & Conditions
quiz-new.availability-dates-conditions-s.what: An attempt can only continue in the browser session where it started.
quiz-new.availability-dates-conditions-s.when: Reducing sharing of a quiz session.
quiz-new.availability-dates-conditions-s.verify: Reopen the page and confirm the saved setting matches what the instructor asked for.
gotchas: If a learner’s browser crashes or they switch devices, they may be locked out mid-attempt and need help from the instructor.
tickets: “My browser crashed and now I can’t get back into the quiz.”

quiz-new.timing-display.set-time-limit.title: Set time limit
quiz-new.timing-display.set-time-limit.what: Gives the quiz a time limit. Use Timer Settings to choose when the clock starts and what happens when it runs out.
howTo: Open Timer Settings to choose the expiry behaviour.
quiz-new.timing-display.set-time-limit.verify: The panel summary shows the time limit.
gotchas: Learners with accommodations get their extra time from Classlist automatically. Do not create a second quiz for them.
tickets: “How do I make the quiz 60 minutes?”

quiz-new.timing-display.time-limit.title: Time limit (minutes)
quiz-new.timing-display.time-limit.what: The number of minutes each learner gets for an attempt.
quiz-new.timing-display.time-limit.when: When an instructor asks about this part of the page or reports that it is not working as expected.
quiz-new.timing-display.time-limit.verify: Reopen the page and confirm the saved setting matches what the instructor asked for.
gotchas: Accommodation multipliers apply to this number, so a 1.5 multiplier on 40 minutes gives 60.

quiz-new.timing-display.asynchronous.title: Asynchronous timer
quiz-new.timing-display.asynchronous.what: Each learner’s clock starts when they open the quiz, so everyone gets the full time limit whenever they start.
quiz-new.timing-display.asynchronous.when: When an instructor asks about this part of the page or reports that it is not working as expected.
quiz-new.timing-display.asynchronous.verify: Reopen the page and confirm the saved setting matches what the instructor asked for.
howTo: Open Timer Settings and choose the asynchronous start.

quiz-new.timing-display.auto-submit-when.title: Auto-submit when time is up
quiz-new.timing-display.auto-submit-when.what: When the time limit runs out the attempt is submitted automatically with the answers saved so far.
quiz-new.timing-display.auto-submit-when.when: When an instructor asks about this part of the page or reports that it is not working as expected.
quiz-new.timing-display.auto-submit-when.verify: Reopen the page and confirm the saved setting matches what the instructor asked for.
gotchas: Answers are saved as learners move through the quiz. An answer typed but not saved in the last seconds may be lost.
tickets: “The quiz submitted itself before I finished.”
howTo: Under When the time limit expires, choose Automatically submit.

quiz-new.control.timer-settings.title: Timer settings
quiz-new.control.timer-settings.what: Chooses when the clock starts and what happens when time runs out.
quiz-new.control.timer-settings.when: When an instructor asks about this part of the page or reports that it is not working as expected.
quiz-new.control.timer-settings.verify: Reopen the page and confirm the saved setting matches what the instructor asked for.

quiz-new.timing-display.paging.title: Paging
quiz-new.timing-display.paging.what: How many questions appear per page: all together, one per page, or a page per section.
quiz-new.timing-display.paging.when: One question per page suits long quizzes and limits lost work if a connection drops.
quiz-new.timing-display.paging.verify: Reopen the page and confirm the saved setting matches what the instructor asked for.
gotchas: With one question per page, check whether learners may move back to earlier pages.

quiz-new.timing-display-shuffle-quiz.shu.title: Shuffle questions
quiz-new.timing-display-shuffle-quiz.shu.what: Shows the questions in a different order for each learner.
quiz-new.timing-display-shuffle-quiz.shu.verify: Reopen the page and confirm the saved setting matches what the instructor asked for.
gotchas: It does not shuffle inside sub-sections. Set shuffling on each section too if needed.

quiz-new.timing-display-display.allow-hi.title: Allow hints
quiz-new.timing-display-display.allow-hi.what: Shows the hints written on individual questions.
quiz-new.timing-display-display.allow-hi.verify: Reopen the page and confirm the saved setting matches what the instructor asked for.

quiz-new.timing-display-display.hide-que.title: Hide annotation tools
quiz-new.timing-display-display.hide-que.what: Removes the highlighting and strike-through tools learners can use while answering.
quiz-new.timing-display-display.hide-que.when: When an instructor asks about this part of the page or reports that it is not working as expected.
quiz-new.timing-display-display.hide-que.verify: Reopen the page and confirm the saved setting matches what the instructor asked for.
gotchas: Some learners rely on these tools as an accessibility aid. Check before hiding them.

quiz-new.timing-display-display.hide-que.title: Hide point values
quiz-new.timing-display-display.hide-que.what: Learners do not see how many points each question is worth while answering.
quiz-new.timing-display-display.hide-que.when: When an instructor asks about this part of the page or reports that it is not working as expected.
quiz-new.timing-display-display.hide-que.verify: Reopen the page and confirm the saved setting matches what the instructor asked for.

quiz-new.timing-display-display.disable-.title: Disable messages during the quiz
quiz-new.timing-display-display.disable-.what: Blocks Brightspace email, instant messages and alerts while a learner has an attempt open.
quiz-new.timing-display-display.disable-.when: Exams where outside communication should be limited.
quiz-new.timing-display-display.disable-.verify: Reopen the page and confirm the saved setting matches what the instructor asked for.
gotchas: It only affects Brightspace. Learners can still use other apps and devices.

quiz-new.control.manage-header-and-foote.title: Header and footer
quiz-new.control.manage-header-and-foote.what: Adds text above or below the questions, such as a formula sheet or academic integrity statement.
quiz-new.control.manage-header-and-foote.when: When an instructor asks about this part of the page or reports that it is not working as expected.
quiz-new.control.manage-header-and-foote.verify: Reopen the page and confirm the saved setting matches what the instructor asked for.

quiz-new.control.manage-attempts.title: Attempts allowed
quiz-new.control.manage-attempts.what: How many times each learner may take the quiz, and which attempt counts: highest, lowest, average, first or last.
quiz-new.control.manage-attempts.when: Practice quizzes with retakes, or exams with one attempt.
howTo: Choose which attempt is kept as the grade.
quiz-new.control.manage-attempts.verify: The panel summary shows the attempt count.
gotchas: To give one learner an extra attempt, use Special Access with Override attempts allowed, or reset their attempt in Grade. Do not raise attempts for the whole class.
tickets: “A student’s internet died. Can they try again?”

quiz-new.attempts-completion-attempts.1-.title: Attempts allowed
quiz-new.attempts-completion-attempts.1-.what: How many times each learner may take the quiz, and which attempt counts: highest, lowest, average, first or last.
quiz-new.attempts-completion-attempts.1-.when: Practice quizzes with retakes, or exams with one attempt.
howTo: Choose which attempt is kept as the grade.
quiz-new.attempts-completion-attempts.1-.verify: The panel summary shows the attempt count.
gotchas: To give one learner an extra attempt, use Special Access with Override attempts allowed, or reset their attempt in Grade. Do not raise attempts for the whole class.
tickets: “A student’s internet died. Can they try again?”

quiz-new.attempts-completion.category.title: Category
quiz-new.attempts-completion.category.what: Groups this quiz with others on the Quizzes list page, such as “Midterms” or “Weekly Labs”. This is a display category in Quizzes, separate from gradebook categories.
quiz-new.attempts-completion.category.when: Keeping a long list of activities tidy for instructors and learners.
howTo: Pick an existing category, or create one with Edit Categories on the Quizzes page.
quiz-new.attempts-completion.category.verify: The quiz appears under that heading on the list page.
gotchas: This does not change grade weighting. Weighting comes from the gradebook category in Grades.
tickets: “Why doesn’t moving the quiz to a category change the weighting?”

quiz-new.attempts-completion.notificatio.title: Notification email
quiz-new.attempts-completion.notificatio.what: Sends an email to the addresses entered whenever a learner completes an attempt.
quiz-new.attempts-completion.notificatio.when: An instructor or TA wants to know the moment work arrives.
howTo: Enter one or more addresses separated by commas.
quiz-new.attempts-completion.notificatio.verify: A test submission sends an email to the address.
gotchas: For a large class this can mean hundreds of emails. Suggest it only for small classes or important deadlines.
tickets: “I want an email when students finish the quiz.”

quiz-new.evaluation-feedback.auto-publis.title: Auto-publish results
quiz-new.evaluation-feedback.auto-publis.what: Learners see their result as soon as they submit, and the score is published.
quiz-new.evaluation-feedback.auto-publis.when: Auto-graded quizzes where instant feedback helps.
howTo: Choose what learners see under When published, display to learners.
quiz-new.evaluation-feedback.auto-publis.verify: A test attempt shows its result right after submission.
gotchas: With written response questions the score shown is incomplete until those are marked.
tickets: “Students can see their marks immediately. Can I stop that?”

quiz-new.evaluation-feedback.synchronize.title: Sync to grade book on publish
quiz-new.evaluation-feedback.synchronize.what: When results are published, the score is sent to the linked gradebook item.
quiz-new.evaluation-feedback.synchronize.when: When an instructor asks about this part of the page or reports that it is not working as expected.
howTo: Link the quiz to a grade item first; the option becomes available.
gotchas: Greyed out means the quiz is not in the gradebook yet.
tickets: “The quiz is graded but the mark is not in Grades.”

quiz-new.evaluation-feedback-when-publis.title: What learners see after publishing
quiz-new.evaluation-feedback-when-publis.what: Controls how much a learner sees after their attempt is published: the grade, and whether questions, their answers and correct answers are shown.
quiz-new.evaluation-feedback-when-publis.when: Balancing feedback against keeping questions secure for later sittings.
howTo: Choose whether the attempt grade shows.
Choose which questions are shown: none, incorrect only, or all.
Use Customize Quiz Results Displays for more control.
quiz-new.evaluation-feedback-when-publis.verify: Reopen the page and confirm the saved setting matches what the instructor asked for.
gotchas: Showing correct answers while some learners have not yet written the quiz can leak the answers.
tickets: “Students want to see which questions they got wrong.”

quiz-new.evaluation-feedback-when-publis.title: What learners see after publishing
quiz-new.evaluation-feedback-when-publis.what: Controls how much a learner sees after their attempt is published: the grade, and whether questions, their answers and correct answers are shown.
quiz-new.evaluation-feedback-when-publis.when: Balancing feedback against keeping questions secure for later sittings.
howTo: Choose whether the attempt grade shows.
Choose which questions are shown: none, incorrect only, or all.
Use Customize Quiz Results Displays for more control.
quiz-new.evaluation-feedback-when-publis.verify: Reopen the page and confirm the saved setting matches what the instructor asked for.
gotchas: Showing correct answers while some learners have not yet written the quiz can leak the answers.
tickets: “Students want to see which questions they got wrong.”

quiz-new.control.customize-quiz-results-.title: Customize results displays
quiz-new.control.customize-quiz-results-.what: Adds extra result views, for example showing correct answers only after the quiz end date.
quiz-new.control.customize-quiz-results-.when: Releasing answers to everyone once the quiz has closed.
howTo: Add a display with a release date or condition.
quiz-new.control.customize-quiz-results-.verify: Reopen the page and confirm the saved setting matches what the instructor asked for.

quiz-new.control.manage-learning-objecti.title: Learning objectives
quiz-new.control.manage-learning-objecti.what: Aligns this quiz to course outcomes or standards so achievement can be reported against them.
quiz-new.control.manage-learning-objecti.when: Programs that report on outcomes or competencies.
howTo: Select the outcomes this activity assesses.
quiz-new.control.manage-learning-objecti.verify: The outcomes are listed under Learning Objectives.
gotchas: Alignment alone does not record achievement. Instructors still evaluate against the outcome.
tickets: “How do I connect this to our program outcomes?”

quiz-new.evaluation-feedback-learning-ob.title: Learning objectives
quiz-new.evaluation-feedback-learning-ob.what: Aligns this quiz to course outcomes or standards so achievement can be reported against them.

assignment-new.right-column.availability.what: Start and end dates, release conditions and special access for this assignment.

Set start and end dates, release conditions or special access.

assignment-new.availability-dates-condit.title: Start Date
assignment-new.availability-dates-condit.where: Assignments > New Assignment > Availability Dates & Conditions
assignment-new.availability-dates-condit.what: The assignment cannot be opened before this time. Depending on display settings, learners may still see it listed.
assignment-new.availability-dates-condit.when: Use with the Due Date to control exactly when work can happen.
howTo: Set the Start Date date and time.
assignment-new.availability-dates-condit.verify: Reopen the activity and check the saved date and time.
gotchas: For one learner who needs different dates, use Special Access instead of moving the dates for the whole class.
tickets: “My students can already see the assignment before it should open.”

assignment-new.availability-dates-condit.title: End Date
assignment-new.availability-dates-condit.where: Assignments > New Assignment > Availability Dates & Conditions
assignment-new.availability-dates-condit.what: Access closes at this time. After it, learners can no longer submit, unless they have special access.
assignment-new.availability-dates-condit.when: Use with the Due Date to control exactly when work can happen.
howTo: Set the End Date date and time.
assignment-new.availability-dates-condit.verify: Reopen the activity and check the saved date and time.
gotchas: For one learner who needs different dates, use Special Access instead of moving the dates for the whole class.
tickets: “A student missed the deadline and needs to submit late.”

assignment-new.control.add-release-condi.title: Release conditions
assignment-new.control.add-release-condi.where: Assignments > New Assignment > Availability Dates & Conditions
assignment-new.control.add-release-condi.what: Hides the assignment until a learner meets a condition, such as completing a content topic or scoring above a threshold on another activity.
assignment-new.control.add-release-condi.when: Sequencing work, such as unlocking a quiz only after the reading is viewed.
howTo: Choose Add Release Condition and pick the condition type.
assignment-new.control.add-release-condi.verify: Check as a test learner, or confirm the condition is listed under Release Conditions.
gotchas: This is the most common cause of “my student cannot see it”. Always check release conditions before anything else.
Conditions combine. With several conditions, check whether all or any must be met.
tickets: “One student can’t see the assignment but everyone else can.”
